en: Black and white interior view of a traditional log-house room with wooden plank floor and exposed beams. On the left stands an ornate painted cabinet with a slanted writing surface, beside a couple of wooden chairs. In the center is a small-paned window. On the right side there is a settee and chairs around a round table covered with a white tablecloth, set with cups and saucers. Pictures and a mirror hang on the wooden wall. Printed caption text appears along the bottom border of the image.
